title: Genomic characteristics of the first five monkeypox virus clade Ib cases in Thailand: August 2024–March 2025
abstract: ABSTRACT Following the emergence of monkeypox virus clade Ib in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in August 2024, the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern because of sustained transmission and international spread. We characterized the first clade Ib cases detected in Thailand between August 2024 and March 2025 and assessed their phylogenetic relationships. Whole-genome sequencing was performed from lesion swabs of suspected cases. Phylogenetic analysis, incorporating clade Ia ( DQ011155.1 ) and global clade Ib sequences from GISAID, confirmed all Thai isolates as clade Ib. The genomes showed close relatedness to clade Ib viruses reported internationally, consistent with patients’ travel histories. All isolates exhibited a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region and 52–61 amino acid substitutions compared with the clade Ia reference. Genome sequences were submitted to GISAID and NCBI to support outbreak response and improve understanding of epidemiologic patterns, enabling more effective public health interventions. IMPORTANCE On 14 August 2024, the World Health Organization declared the monkeypox virus outbreak in Africa a public health emergency of international concern following the emergence of clade Ib. One week later, Thailand confirmed the first monkeypox clade Ib case in Asia. Through whole-genome sequencing and phylogenomic analysis of five cases detected between August 2024 and March 2025, we identified a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region that distinguishes clade Ib from clade Ia. This deletion directly affects the performance of some commercial real-time PCR assays designed for clade Ia, which rely on amplification of the missing genomic region. Our findings highlight important diagnostic limitations that could lead to misinterpretation or reduced sensitivity in routine testing. Beyond confirming regional introduction linked to global spread, this study underscores the critical role of genomic surveillance in ensuring accurate diagnosis, monitoring viral evolution, and strengthening outbreak response as monkeypox continues to expand internationally.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the genomic characteristics of the first five monkeypox virus clade Ib cases in Thailand between August 2024 and March 2025. It confirmed that these isolates belong to clade Ib, showing close relatedness to international clade Ib viruses and exhibiting a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region and 52–61 amino acid substitutions compared with clade Ia. The research highlights the importance of genomic surveillance in tracking viral evolution and improving diagnostic accuracy, especially as clade Ib continues to spread globally. The study's findings underscore the need for updated diagnostic methods to account for these genetic differences, which affect the performance of some commercial real-time PCR assays. While the study is limited to a small sample size and relies on genomic data, the evidence is strong due to the use of global reference sequences and direct sequencing of the Thai isolates. The results contribute to understanding the epidemiologic patterns of monkeypox and support more effective public health interventions.

abstract_zh: 摘要 2024 年 8 月刚果民主共和国出现猴痘病毒 Ib 分支后,由于 传播 的持续传播和国际传播,世界卫生组织宣布该病毒为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。我们对 2024 年 8 月至 2025 年 3 月期间在泰国发现的第一批 Ib 分支病例进行了特征分析,并评估了它们的系统发育关系。对疑似病例的病变拭子进行全 基因组 测序。系统发育分析,结合来自 GISAID 的进化枝 Ia (DQ011155.1) 和全局进化枝 Ib 序列,确认所有泰国分离株均为进化枝 Ib。基因组 显示与国际报道的 Ib 分支病毒密切相关,与患者的旅行史一致。与进化枝 Ia 参考相比,所有分离株在 C3L 基因区域均表现出 1,140 bp 缺失和 52-61 个氨基酸取代。基因组 序列已提交给 GISAID 和 NCBI,以支持 暴发 响应并提高对流行病学模式的理解,从而实现更有效的公共卫生干预措施。重要性 2024 年 8 月 14 日,世界卫生组织宣布非洲猴痘病毒 暴发 为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件,继出现 Ib 分支后。一周后,泰国确认亚洲首例猴痘分支Ib病例。通过对 2024 年 8 月至 2025 年 3 月期间检测到的 5 个病例进行全 基因组 测序和系统发育分析,我们在 C3L 基因区域中发现了一个 1,140 bp 的缺失,该缺失将分支 Ib 与分支 Ia 区分开来。这种缺失直接影响了一些为进化枝 Ia 设计的商业实时 PCR 检测的性能,这些检测依赖于缺失基因组区域的扩增。我们的研究结果强调了重要的诊断局限性,这些局限性可能导致常规检测中的误解或敏感性降低。除了确认区域引入与全球传播相关之外,这项研究还强调了 基因组监测 在确保准确的 诊断、监测病毒 进化 以及随着猴痘继续在国际上蔓延而加强 暴发 应对方面的关键作用。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 需要开展这项研究来了解猴痘病毒 Ib 分支在泰国的出现及其对公共卫生的影响,因为由于 传播 的持续存在以及 2024 年 8 月在刚果民主共和国出现后的国际传播,世界卫生组织宣布该病毒为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。

analysis_zh.methods: 对疑似病例的病变拭子进行全 基因组 测序,并进行系统发育分析,将泰国分离株与 Ia 分支和 Ib 分支序列进行比较,鉴定出 C3L 基因区域的 1,140 bp 缺失和氨基酸替换。
analysis_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析证实所有泰国分离株均为 Ib 分支,与国际 Ib 分支病毒密切相关,与 Ia 分支参考相比,C3L 基因区域有 1,140 bp 缺失和 52-61 个氨基酸取代。

title: Comparative pathogenicity study of monkeypox virus Clade Ib and Clade IIb in a rabbit model
abstract: ABSTRACT Mpox has emerged as a significant public health concern, spreading across continents with the emergence of new variants. Clade IIb, from the recent global outbreak, and the newly identified Clade Ib have shown changes in transmission dynamics and possibly in severity. We developed a New Zealand White rabbit model of Mpox by using a combination of intradermal and intravenous routes of administration. Following infection, the rabbits developed erythematous papular lesions on the skin, which progressed to crust and scab formation by the second week, ultimately leading to healing and seroconversion. Infection with the Clade Ib and IIb.A.2.1 lineages revealed that both Monkeypox virus (MPXV) variants caused skin and testicular lesions, as well as viral excretion from the nasal cavity, skin, and testicular tissue. However, there were no significant differences in disease severity between the two variants. These findings suggest that this rabbit model could be useful for evaluating countermeasures against MPXV.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using a rabbit model, where New Zealand White rabbits were infected with the Monkeypox virus Clade Ib and Clade IIb.A.2.1 lineages. The infection was administered through intradermal and intravenous routes.
analysis.methods: A New Zealand White rabbit model was developed for Mpox by using a combination of intradermal and intravenous routes of administration. The study involved observing the progression of lesions and viral excretion in the rabbits.
analysis.main_results: Infection with the Clade Ib and IIb.A.2.1 lineages revealed that both Monkeypox virus (MPXV) variants caused skin and testicular lesions, as well as viral excretion from the nasal cavity, skin, and testicular tissue.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares the pathogenicity of Clade Ib and Clade IIb of the monkeypox virus using a rabbit model. The research was motivated by the growing public health concern of Mpox and the emergence of new variants. The study involved infecting New Zealand White rabbits with both clades through intradermal and intravenous routes. The results showed that both variants caused skin and testicular lesions, as well as viral excretion from the nasal cavity, skin, and testicular tissue. However, no significant differences in disease severity were observed between the two variants. The findings suggest that the rabbit model could be useful for evaluating countermeasures against MPXV. The study contributes to understanding the transmission dynamics and severity of different clades of the monkeypox virus. The evidence is moderate due to the use of an animal model and the absence of human clinical data.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Mpox has emerged as a significant public health concern, spreading across continents with the emergence of new variants. The study aimed to compare the pathogenicity of Clade Ib and Clade IIb of the monkeypox virus.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using a rabbit model, where New Zealand White rabbits were infected with the Monkeypox virus Clade Ib and Clade IIb.A.2.1 lineages. The infection was administered through intradermal and intravenous routes.
analysis_en.methods: A New Zealand White rabbit model was developed for Mpox by using a combination of intradermal and intravenous routes of administration. The study involved observing the progression of lesions and viral excretion in the rabbits.
analysis_en.main_results: Infection with the Clade Ib and IIb.A.2.1 lineages revealed that both Monkeypox virus (MPXV) variants caused skin and testicular lesions, as well as viral excretion from the nasal cavity, skin, and testicular tissue.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings suggest that this rabbit model could be useful for evaluating countermeasures against MPXV. The study provides insights into the pathogenicity of different clades of the monkeypox virus in a controlled animal model.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of countermeasures against MPXV and contribute to understanding the transmission dynamics and severity of different clades of the monkeypox virus.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an animal model and does not account for human variability. The evidence is moderate as it is based on a controlled rabbit model and does not include human clinical data.

title_zh: 猴痘病毒Clade Ib和Clade IIb在兔模型中的致病性比较研究
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Mpox has emerged as a significant public health concern, spreading across continents with the emergence of new variants. Clade IIb, from the recent global outbreak, and the newly identified Clade Ib have shown changes in transmission dynamics and possibly in severity. We developed a New Zealand White rabbit model of Mpox by using a combination of intradermal and intravenous routes of administration. Following infection, the rabbits developed erythematous papular lesions on the skin, which progressed to crust and scab formation by the second week, ultimately leading to healing and seroconversion. Infection with the Clade Ib and IIb.A.2.1 lineages revealed that both Monkeypox virus (MPXV) variants caused skin and testicular lesions, as well as viral excretion from the nasal cavity, skin, and testicular tissue. However, there were no significant differences in disease severity between the two variants. These findings suggest that this rabbit model could be useful for evaluating countermeasures against MPXV.

title: COGNITIVE-BEHAVIORAL ASPECTS OF STUDENTS’ KNOWLEDGE, ATTITUDES, AND PRACTICES TOWARD MONKEYPOX: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW
abstract: Background: Monkeypox (mpox) has infected 103,048 people and caused 229 deaths from January 2022 to July 2024. Approximately 83.6% of cases were associated with sexual activity, highlighting the important role of behavioral factors in disease transmission. Inadequate knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) among students may contribute to misinformation and suboptimal preventive behaviors, particularly among students in health-related disciplines who become future healthcare professionals. Purpose: This systematic review aimed to identify the levels and factors associated with KAP regarding mpox among students. Methods: A comprehensive literature search through ScienceDirect, Scopus, and PubMed up to September 2024 using predefined keywords and Boolean operators. Eligible articles were screened according to predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. The quality of the included studies was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) critical appraisal checklist. Results: Of 44 articles identified across three databases, six studies met the inclusion criteria. Three of six studies reported good knowledge, three of five reported positive attitudes, and one of two studies reported good practices. Educational, information-related, and demographic factors were associated with KAP. Conclusion: Students’ KAP toward mpox varied across settings, with knowledge ranging from poor to good, generally favorable attitudes, and limited evidence on preventive practices. These findings support the integration of emerging infectious diseases into relevant curricula and improved access to reliable health information among students.
journal: Journal of Public Health Research and Community Health Development

title: Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025
abstract: In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023-May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%-16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%-96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%-46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%-85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response.

To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023-May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%-16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%-96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%-46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%-85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究需要解决 猴痘病毒 潜在未被识别的 传播 的科学和公共卫生问题,因为北卡罗来纳州卫生与公众服务部在上次报告 5 个月后发现了 猴痘 分支 II 的新病例。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 +17 天的窗口对废水检测和临床病例进行分析,以识别时间上一致的 猴痘 病例。该研究包括在选定的废水处理场进行非天花 正痘病毒 测试。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,废水 监测 的敏感性较低,但为公共卫生应对提供了补充意识,凸显了其作为早期检测和监测工具的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,废水 监测 可能是识别 猴痘病毒 活动和支持公共卫生应对工作的有价值的方法,特别是在临床报告有限的地区。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究检测 猴痘病毒 的敏感性较低,这可能限制了其对 监测 的有效性。然而,由于使用了定义的时间窗口以及对废水和临床数据的分析,证据的强度中等。

title: High-content image-based screening reveals vaccinia virus membrane proteins as potential regulators of LC3 lipidation.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Autophagy is a catabolic process used for the degradation of organelles and proteins, and it also functions as a cellular defense mechanism, known as xenophagy, during infection. Vaccinia virus (VACV), the prototypic poxvirus, replicates exclusively in the cytoplasm of host cells. It is known that VACV infection causes LC3 lipidation while preventing autophagosome formation, yet the viral protein(s) responsible have not been identified. Using infection time-course Western blotting and a phospholipase D band-shift assay, we show that VACV drives genuine LC3-II formation, rather than a block in pro-LC3 cleavage, and that this depends on early viral gene expression. To identify the gene(s) involved, we generated a dsRed-LC3-I-GFP reporter cell line and developed an image-based screening approach based on single-cell LC3 granularity, which we applied to 80 early VACV genes. The screen revealed that VACV-induced lipidation is regulated in both directions. Follow-up validation identified H3 as a negative regulator and the membrane proteins A14, L5, and G5 as positive contributors to LC3 lipidation. These findings provide the first systematic map of VACV genes affecting LC3 lipidation and suggest that the interplay between VACV and autophagy is more directed than previously thought. IMPORTANCE: Poxviruses, including vaccinia virus and the closely related monkeypox virus, remain a significant public health concern and are increasingly exploited as vaccine and cancer immunotherapy vectors. Understanding how these viruses manipulate host defenses is therefore important for both antiviral and biotechnology applications. Autophagy is a key cellular defense pathway, and vaccinia virus is known to trigger lipidation of the autophagy protein LC3 while blocking productive autophagy, although the viral genes driving this remained unknown. Using an image-based screening strategy, we identify several early vaccinia virus genes that increase or decrease LC3 lipidation, showing that the virus actively regulates this process in both directions. These findings reveal a more targeted interaction between vaccinia virus and host autophagy than previously recognized and provide a broadly applicable screening approach for studying virus-autophagy interactions.

title_zh: 基于高内涵图像的筛选揭示痘苗病毒膜蛋白是 LC3 脂化的潜在调节剂。
source_body_en: UNLABELLED: Autophagy is a catabolic process used for the degradation of organelles and proteins, and it also functions as a cellular defense mechanism, known as xenophagy, during infection. Vaccinia virus (VACV), the prototypic poxvirus, replicates exclusively in the cytoplasm of host cells. It is known that VACV infection causes LC3 lipidation while preventing autophagosome formation, yet the viral protein(s) responsible have not been identified. Using infection time-course Western blotting and a phospholipase D band-shift assay, we show that VACV drives genuine LC3-II formation, rather than a block in pro-LC3 cleavage, and that this depends on early viral gene expression. To identify the gene(s) involved, we generated a dsRed-LC3-I-GFP reporter cell line and developed an image-based screening approach based on single-cell LC3 granularity, which we applied to 80 early VACV genes. The screen revealed that VACV-induced lipidation is regulated in both directions. Follow-up validation identified H3 as a negative regulator and the membrane proteins A14, L5, and G5 as positive contributors to LC3 lipidation. These findings provide the first systematic map of VACV genes affecting LC3 lipidation and suggest that the interplay between VACV and autophagy is more directed than previously thought. IMPORTANCE: Poxviruses, including vaccinia virus and the closely related monkeypox virus, remain a significant public health concern and are increasingly exploited as vaccine and cancer immunotherapy vectors. Understanding how these viruses manipulate host defenses is therefore important for both antiviral and biotechnology applications. Autophagy is a key cellular defense pathway, and vaccinia virus is known to trigger lipidation of the autophagy protein LC3 while blocking productive autophagy, although the viral genes driving this remained unknown. Using an image-based screening strategy, we identify several early vaccinia virus genes that increase or decrease LC3 lipidation, showing that the virus actively regulates this process in both directions. These findings reveal a more targeted interaction between vaccinia virus and host autophagy than previously recognized and provide a broadly applicable screening approach for studying virus-autophagy interactions.

title: Municipality size and epidemiological characteristics among confirmed mpox cases in Spain
abstract: In 2022, a multistate mpox outbreak represented a new global health challenge and highlighted sexual contact as the main route of transmission. Spain reported the highest number of cases in Europe but showed an irregular distribution of cases across its territory. This study aims to describe the characteristics of mpox cases among individuals living in large cities versus smaller municipalities, and to examine whether municipality size is associated with mpox incidence and with epidemiological and clinical characteristics among confirmed cases. This is a cross‐sectional study of mpox cases in men aged ≥ 16 years confirmed between June 2022 and January 2023 in seven Spanish regions. Epidemiological and clinical variables were analysed in large cities (population ≥ 200 000) and smaller municipalities. Descriptive analyses were performed. Odds ratios (aOR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI95%) were obtained through logistic regression models to describe characteristics of mpox cases among individuals. To assess differences in cumulative incidence according to municipality size, cumulative incidence ratios (aCIR CI95%) were obtained through Poisson regression models with robust variance. Among the 1,162 reported mpox cases, 776 (66.8%) were from large urban areas. Among mpox cases, living in large cities was significantly associated with being born in low-income countries (aOR = 2.1, 1.2–3.5), having a previous sexually transmitted infection (STI) (aOR = 1.6, 1.1–2.3), participating in chemsex (aOR = 1.7, 1.0–2.7), having sex in private leisure venues (aOR = 1.5, 1.1–2.2), using pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) (aOR = 1.7, 1.1–2.5), and regularly using condoms during casual sex (aOR = 1.9, 1.3–2.9). Clinical complications were less frequent in large cities (aOR = 0.4, 0.2–0.7). Living in a large city was associated with a higher cumulative incidence of mpox (aCIR = 2.7; 1.9–3.7) compared with living in smaller municipalities. Living in a large city was associated with a higher cumulative incidence of mpox. It was also associated with characteristics linked to chemsex practices, sexual encounters in private leisure venues and previous STI diagnosis. These findings support considering municipality size and urban social dynamics when planning public health responses to mpox.

title: In Vitro Selection and Characterization of Tecovirimat-resistant Mpox Virus.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox virus (MPXV) is the causative agent of mpox, a disease characterized by skin lesions, and remains a global threat since the recent 2022 outbreak. Tecovirimat is an antiviral agent that inhibits MPXV replication in vitro and in vivo by targeting the viral phospholipase VP37 protein and blocking viral envelope wrapping. Although tecovirimat has been administered to many mpox patients, the emergence of tecovirimat-resistant MPXVs carrying mutations in the VP37 protein has been reported, particularly in immunocompromised individuals. However, the impact of these respective mutations on drug susceptibility and viral fitness have not been fully characterized. METHODS: Tecovirimat was applied as a selective pressure in vitro to isolate MPXV variants carrying clinically observed VP37 substitutions. Drug susceptibility among the major VP37 mutations was compared, and the cellular fitness of the isolated viruses was evaluated. RESULTS: The VP37-N267D and -Y258C mutants showed markedly reduced susceptibility to tecovirimat compared with the VP37-I372N and -T245I (+I7L-A388S) mutants, while retaining susceptibility to an alternative anti-MPXV agent, brincidofovir. The VP37-I372N, T245I (+I7L-A388S), Y258C, and N267D mutants exhibited viral fitness comparable to that of the parental virus in A549 and Vero cells, as well as in MRC-5 and HaCaT cells. CONCLUSIONS: These findings provide insights into the phenotype of each VP37 mutation and emphasize the importance of developing antivirals with distinct mechanisms of action to effectively combat tecovirimat-resistant MPXV.

title: Dynamics and bifurcation analysis of an SEQIRV model for Mpox transmission under vaccination, quarantine, and behavioural responses
abstract: The re-emergence of the Mpox virus in 2022 indicates the need for effective intervention strategies to prevent disease. This study develops a deterministic SEQIRV model to understand the disease dynamics and also analyzes the adaptive vaccination strategies, unscheduled quarantine measures, and effect of behavioral responses on disease transmission. The model also investigates the effects of targeted vaccination in several population groups, for example, high-risk groups, men who have sex with men (MSM), and healthcare workers, by combining compartmental epidemiological modeling with dynamic transmission analysis. We investigate how different vaccination strategies influence the direction of bifurcation and analyze the corresponding basins of attraction for various initial exposed and infected population levels. The results reveal that an initially high vaccination rate is less effective than maintaining a high vaccination rate throughout the outbreak, suggesting that sustained vaccination efforts are essential for long-term epidemic control. In addition, early implementation of quarantine significantly reduces the epidemic peak; on the other hand, quarantine leakage weakens the effectiveness of quarantine and may fuel disease persistence. The results also demonstrate that behavioral responses, such as increased awareness and government-induced restrictions, significantly reduce disease spread. Finally, this study identifies key intervention strategies to support policymakers in designing and implementing effective control measures against emerging zoonotic diseases such as Mpox.

title: Clinical Mimickers of Mpox: A Case Series from a Tropical Referral Center
abstract: Mpox is a zoonotic disease caused by the monkeypox virus, a double-stranded DNA virus belonging to the genus Orthopoxvirus. The World Health Organization (WHO) declared mpox a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) in July 2022 amid the global clade IIb outbreak and again in August 2024 following an increase in cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo associated with clades Ia and Ib. Despite increased awareness, diagnosing mpox remains challenging because its clinical manifestations often overlap with those of other infectious and non-infectious conditions. This diagnostic challenge occurs across geographic settings but may be further complicated in tropical regions by the circulation of locally prevalent infections, including arboviral diseases such as dengue and chikungunya. Here, we describe a series of nine patients initially evaluated for suspected mpox, in whom alternative diagnoses were subsequently established.

title: Discovery of Mpox Virus in Bile: A Case with Multiple Coinfections.
abstract: We report the detection of Monkeypox virus (MPXV) nucleic acid in bile from a rash-free patient with advanced HIV and multiple coinfections. This case raises the possibility that MPXV nucleic acid may be detectable in bile and represents, to our knowledge, the first reported detection of MPXV nucleic acid in human bile. The clinical significance of this observation requires further study.
journal: International journal of infectious diseases : IJID : official publication of the International Society for Infectious Diseases

title: Computational Design of a Phytochemical Drug Candidate Targeting Monkeypox Virus D8l and D4r/A20r Complex: An in Silico Study of Pharmacophoreand Molecular Prediction
abstract: Due to its rapid spread and the absence of approved antiviral treatments, Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has been declared as a global health emergency. This study aimed to identify possible drug candidates targeting MPXV vaccinia proteins D8L which is involved in host cell entry, and D4R/A20R Complex responsible for viral DNA replication and host cell entry. Phytochemical and pharmacophore compounds were assessed against MPXV target proteins using an in silico quantitative method that combined computational screening, molecular docking, and protein–ligand interaction analysis. Protein and ligand libraries were obtained from RCSB PDB, NCBI BLASTp, PubChem, and DrugBank. Drug-likeness and pharmacokinetic properties were assessed using ADMETLab 3.0. This screening reduced the initial number of 1,854 phytochemical and 808 pharmacophore compounds to 168 phytochemical and 11 pharmacophore candidates. The compounds that satisfied the former criterion were subjected to molecular docking and cavity assessment using CB-Dock which was then followed by an interaction analysis using PLIP. The leading ligands were then further evaluated using a criterion derived from docking rank, hydrogen bonds, and hydrophobic interactions gained. Among the three (3) methods, Artonol A and Camptothecin showed identical strong binding affinities of −9.1 kcal/mol and achieved the highest scores against their respective proteins. These findings support further experimental validation by in vitro and in vivo tests as possible choices for treating MPXV.
journal: American Journal of Bioscience and Bioinformatics

title: Discovery of the nucleoside analogue FMAU as a broad-spectrum anti-orthopoxvirus inhibitor in vitro and in vivo using a structure-guided hit expansion strategy.
abstract: Mpox remains a critical public health threat worldwide, and currently available therapeutics against orthopoxvirus infections remain very limited. In this study, we identified 2'-deoxy-2'-fluoro-5-methyl-1-β-D-arabinofuranosyluracil (FMAU) as a broad-spectrum anti-orthopoxvirus candidate through nucleos(t)ide analogue library screening combined with a structure-guided hit expansion strategy. In Vero cells, FMAU exerted potent in vitro antiviral activity against vaccinia virus (VACV) and monkeypox virus (MPXV), with EC50 values of 1.99 μM and 30 nM, respectively, while exhibiting no apparent cytotoxicity, as reflected by a CC50 value greater than 200 μM. In vivo mouse studies further showed that FMAU treatment provided full protection against lethal VACV and MPXV challenges, while significantly reducing viral loads in lung tissues. Importantly, oral FMAU administration retained potent therapeutic efficacy against MPXV in a mouse model of MPXV infection. Collectively, our findings identify FMAU as a promising oral anti-orthopoxvirus drug candidate and support its further preclinical evaluation.

title_zh: 使用结构引导的命中扩展策略在体外和体内发现核苷类似物 FMAU 作为广谱抗 正痘病毒 抑制剂。
source_body_en: Mpox remains a critical public health threat worldwide, and currently available therapeutics against orthopoxvirus infections remain very limited. In this study, we identified 2'-deoxy-2'-fluoro-5-methyl-1-β-D-arabinofuranosyluracil (FMAU) as a broad-spectrum anti-orthopoxvirus candidate through nucleos(t)ide analogue library screening combined with a structure-guided hit expansion strategy. In Vero cells, FMAU exerted potent in vitro antiviral activity against vaccinia virus (VACV) and monkeypox virus (MPXV), with EC50 values of 1.99 μM and 30 nM, respectively, while exhibiting no apparent cytotoxicity, as reflected by a CC50 value greater than 200 μM. In vivo mouse studies further showed that FMAU treatment provided full protection against lethal VACV and MPXV challenges, while significantly reducing viral loads in lung tissues. Importantly, oral FMAU administration retained potent therapeutic efficacy against MPXV in a mouse model of MPXV infection. Collectively, our findings identify FMAU as a promising oral anti-orthopoxvirus drug candidate and support its further preclinical evaluation.

title: Effect of Behavioral Awareness Delay on the Dynamics of a Discrete-Time SIR Model for Mpox in Kenya: Stability and Neimark–Sacker Bifurcation Analysis
abstract: Aims/ Objectives: To investigate how delayed behavioral awareness affects the dynamics of a discrete-time SIR model for Mpox transmission, with an emphasis on local stability and the occurrence of a Neimark–Sacker bifurcation. Study Design: Theoretical mathematical modeling study with analytical stability analysis and numerical simulation. Place and Duration of Study: Multimedia University of Kenya, Faculty of Science and Technology; research conducted between August 2025 and August 2026. Methodology: A normalized discrete-time SIR model incorporating a population-level behavioral awareness index Bn representing a combination of being informed about Mpox infection risk and adopting protective behavior. A discrete delay t was introduced in the behavioral-awareness response to the infection. The disease-free and endemic equilibria were derived and their local stability was analyzed using linearization and the Jury criterion. For t > 0, the system was linearized about the endemic equilibrium and the spectral radius p examined numerically in MATLAB as t varied. Time-series simulations and phase portraits were used to characterize the resulting dynamics. Time-series simulations and phase portraits were generated to illustrate the dynamics. Results: For the selected baseline parameter configuration (R0 = 2.07), the endemic equilibrium was locally asymptotically stable for shorter delays. As the delay t increased, a complex-conjugate pair of characteristic roots crossed the unit circle at a critical delay of approximately 9–10 weeks. Numerical simulations showed sustained oscillations, consistent with a Neimark–Sacker bifurcation. Conclusion: Delayed behavioral awareness can destabilize the endemic equilibrium and induce oscillatory Mpox dynamics through a Neimark–Sacker bifurcation. The findings support the importance of timely behavioral response and sustained risk communication. The estimated 9–10 week threshold is a model-dependent result under the selected parameter configuration and should not be interpreted as an empirical national estimate for Kenya.

title_zh: 行为意识延迟对肯尼亚 猴痘 离散时间 SIR 模型动态的影响:稳定性和 Neimark-Sacker 分岔分析
source_body_en: Aims/ Objectives: To investigate how delayed behavioral awareness affects the dynamics of a discrete-time SIR model for Mpox transmission, with an emphasis on local stability and the occurrence of a Neimark–Sacker bifurcation. Study Design: Theoretical mathematical modeling study with analytical stability analysis and numerical simulation. Place and Duration of Study: Multimedia University of Kenya, Faculty of Science and Technology; research conducted between August 2025 and August 2026. Methodology: A normalized discrete-time SIR model incorporating a population-level behavioral awareness index Bn representing a combination of being informed about Mpox infection risk and adopting protective behavior. A discrete delay t was introduced in the behavioral-awareness response to the infection. The disease-free and endemic equilibria were derived and their local stability was analyzed using linearization and the Jury criterion. For t > 0, the system was linearized about the endemic equilibrium and the spectral radius p examined numerically in MATLAB as t varied. Time-series simulations and phase portraits were used to characterize the resulting dynamics. Time-series simulations and phase portraits were generated to illustrate the dynamics. Results: For the selected baseline parameter configuration (R0 = 2.07), the endemic equilibrium was locally asymptotically stable for shorter delays. As the delay t increased, a complex-conjugate pair of characteristic roots crossed the unit circle at a critical delay of approximately 9–10 weeks. Numerical simulations showed sustained oscillations, consistent with a Neimark–Sacker bifurcation. Conclusion: Delayed behavioral awareness can destabilize the endemic equilibrium and induce oscillatory Mpox dynamics through a Neimark–Sacker bifurcation. The findings support the importance of timely behavioral response and sustained risk communication. The estimated 9–10 week threshold is a model-dependent result under the selected parameter configuration and should not be interpreted as an empirical national estimate for Kenya.

title: Evaluating U.S. Federal Zoonotic Records Against National One Health Goals: A Multi-LLM Assessment Across COVID-19, Monkeypox, and H5N1
abstract: (1) Background: Zoonotic diseases require coordinated action across human, animal, and environmental health sectors. While substantial research has focused on outbreak prediction, forecasting, and surveillance, less attention has been given to systematically evaluating how One Health principles are reflected in government policy documents. (2) Methods: We developed a multi-large language model (LLM) framework to evaluate 477 U.S. government documents covering COVID-19, monkeypox, and highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1). Agency technical guidance and Federal Register documents were evaluated using a 19-item rubric covering three goals of the U.S. National One Health Framework: coordination and communication, outbreak response, and surveillance. Claude, GPT, and Gemini independently evaluated the documents. Inter-model agreement and human validation were assessed, and sensitivity analyses examined alternative chunk-to-document aggregation thresholds and the potential influence of document length. (3) Results: One Health alignment was generally limited, with no disease × document-type × goal combination exceeding 39%. Document type showed the clearest differences, with agency technical guidance showing approximately 13–31 percentage-point higher alignment than Federal Register documents across the three goals, while differences across diseases were less consistent. Sensitivity analyses supported the main document-type pattern across alternative aggregation thresholds and after restricting Type B documents by length. After excluding one wording-sensitive rubric item, the three LLMs reached unanimous agreement in 87.1% of document-item evaluations, with human–model agreement (Cohen’s κ = 0.513–0.692) comparable to human–human agreement (κ = 0.649). (4) Conclusions: This study introduces a purpose-built policy corpus and structured multi-LLM evaluation framework for examining how One Health principles are reflected in government documents. The clearest differences were observed across document types rather than diseases, and the main findings were generally stable across alternative analytical assumptions. Together, these findings extend zoonotic-disease research beyond outbreak prediction and surveillance toward systematic evaluation of One Health policy alignment.

title_zh: 根据国家统一健康目标评估美国联邦人畜共患记录:针对 COVID-19、猴痘和 H5N1 的多法学硕士评估
source_body_en: (1) Background: Zoonotic diseases require coordinated action across human, animal, and environmental health sectors. While substantial research has focused on outbreak prediction, forecasting, and surveillance, less attention has been given to systematically evaluating how One Health principles are reflected in government policy documents. (2) Methods: We developed a multi-large language model (LLM) framework to evaluate 477 U.S. government documents covering COVID-19, monkeypox, and highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1). Agency technical guidance and Federal Register documents were evaluated using a 19-item rubric covering three goals of the U.S. National One Health Framework: coordination and communication, outbreak response, and surveillance. Claude, GPT, and Gemini independently evaluated the documents. Inter-model agreement and human validation were assessed, and sensitivity analyses examined alternative chunk-to-document aggregation thresholds and the potential influence of document length. (3) Results: One Health alignment was generally limited, with no disease × document-type × goal combination exceeding 39%. Document type showed the clearest differences, with agency technical guidance showing approximately 13–31 percentage-point higher alignment than Federal Register documents across the three goals, while differences across diseases were less consistent. Sensitivity analyses supported the main document-type pattern across alternative aggregation thresholds and after restricting Type B documents by length. After excluding one wording-sensitive rubric item, the three LLMs reached unanimous agreement in 87.1% of document-item evaluations, with human–model agreement (Cohen’s κ = 0.513–0.692) comparable to human–human agreement (κ = 0.649). (4) Conclusions: This study introduces a purpose-built policy corpus and structured multi-LLM evaluation framework for examining how One Health principles are reflected in government documents. The clearest differences were observed across document types rather than diseases, and the main findings were generally stable across alternative analytical assumptions. Together, these findings extend zoonotic-disease research beyond outbreak prediction and surveillance toward systematic evaluation of One Health policy alignment.

title: Facteurs associés à la faible vaccination contre la Mpox à Kinshasa en République Démocratique du Congo
abstract: Introduction: la co-infection VIH–Mpox constitue un défi croissant en raison de la vulnérabilité accrue des personnes vivant avec le virus de l'immunodéficience humaine (VIH) et de la superposition des dynamiques de transmission. Bien que la vaccination soit fortement recommandée dans ce groupe, la couverture vaccinale demeure faible, particulièrement en Afrique. Alors que 35,7% des Les personnes vivant avec le VIH (PvVIH) sont vaccinées au niveau mondial, les taux restent nettement inférieurs dans les pays africains, comme au Nigeria où seulement 5% ont reçu le vaccin. Cette faible couverture limite la prévention des formes graves et souligne la nécessité d'une meilleure stratégie d'accès au vaccin. L'objectif de l'étude était de déterminer les facteurs associés à la faible vaccination des PvVIH contre le Mpox à Kinshasa. Méthodes: il s'agissait d'une étude transversale analytique menée dans 64 établissements de soins de santé répartis dans 16 zones de santé de la ville-province de Kinshasa. Les données ont été recueillies auprès de 518 personnes vivant avec le VIH entre le 5 et le 25 octobre 2025. La collecte a été réalisée au moyen d'un questionnaire structuré et prétesté, administré lors d'entretiens en face à face par des enquêteurs formés. L'analyse statistique a été effectuée à l'aide du logiciel SPSS, version 25, en appliquant un seuil de signification de 5%. Résultats: les résultats montrent que trois personnes vivant avec le VIH sur quatre (75,9%) étaient âgées de 30 ans ou plus. La majorité des participantes étaient de sexe féminin (66,2%), et 30,1% exerçaient comme ménagères. Par ailleurs, 43,6% étaient mariées et 71,2% avaient atteint au moins le niveau d'études secondaires. Concernant les connaissances de Mpox chez PvVIH, seulement 25,3% avaient déjà entendu parler de la Mpox. La proportion de PvVIH vaccinées contre la Mpox était faible, estimée à 5,2%. Les principaux facteurs associés à la faible vaccination étaient connaissances limites des signes de la Mpox, (ORa = 4,8 ; IC95%: 1,72-13,80 ; p < 0,003) ; la stigmatisation liée au VIH (ORa = 5,9 ; IC95%: 2,01-17,68 ; p < 0,001). Conclusion: cette étude met en évidence une très faible couverture vaccinale contre la Mpox parmi les personnes vivant avec le VIH à Kinshasa, avec seulement 5,2% de sujets vaccinés malgré leur vulnéra-bilité accrue. Les faibles connaissances sur la Mpox, la persistance de la stigmatisation et de la discri-mination liées au VIH apparaissent comme des facteurs significativement associés à cette faible vaccina-tion. Ces résultats soulignent des lacunes importantes en matière d'information, de prévention et d'accès équitable aux services de santé. Ils indiquent également la nécessité urgente d'intégrer davantage la vac-cination Mpox dans le continuum de soins VIH, en particulier pour les patients immunodéprimés.

Alors que 35,7% des Les personnes vivant avec le VIH (PvVIH) sont vaccinées au niveau mondial, les taux restent nettement inférieurs dans les pays africains, comme au Nigeria où seulement 5% ont reçu le vaccin. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to determine the factors associated with low vaccination rates against mpox among people living with HIV (PLWH) in Kinshasa, highlighting the challenges posed by co-infection with HIV and mpox, particularly among PLWH in Africa.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted in 64 healthcare facilities across 16 health zones in Kinshasa, involving 518 PLWH between October 5 and October 25, 2025.
analysis.methods: Data were collected through a pre-tested structured questionnaire administered face-to-face by trained interviewers using SPSS version 25 for statistical analysis with a significance level of 5%.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that 75.9% of PLWH were aged 30 years or older, with 66.2% being female and 30.1% working as homemakers. Additionally, 43.6% were married and 71.2% had at least a secondary education level. Only 25.3% had heard of mpox, and the vaccination rate was 5.2%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The main factors associated with low vaccination rates were limited knowledge of mpox symptoms (ORa = 4.8; IC95%: 1.72-13.80; p < 0.003) and HIV-related stigma (ORa = 5.9; IC95%: 2.01-17.68; p < 0.001).
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights significant gaps in information, prevention, and equitable access to health services, emphasizing the urgent need to integrate mpox vaccination into HIV care, especially for immunocompromised patients.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the cross-sectional design, which precludes causal inference, and the potential for selection bias due to the study's setting in Kinshasa. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study in Kinshasa aimed to identify factors associated with low mpox vaccination rates among people living with HIV, finding that limited knowledge and HIV stigma were significant barriers. The study highlights the need for improved information and equitable access to health services.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在确定金沙萨艾滋病毒感染者(PLWH)中与 猴痘 低 疫苗接种 率相关的因素,强调艾滋病毒和 猴痘 共同感染所带来的挑战,特别是在非洲的 PLWH 中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年 10 月 5 日至 25 日期间,在金沙萨 16 个卫生区的 64 个医疗机构中开展了一项分析性横断面研究,涉及 518 名感染者。
elements_zh.methods: 数据通过预先测试的结构化调查问卷收集,由经过培训的访谈员面对面进行,使用 SPSS 25 版进行统计分析,显着性水平为 5%。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果显示,75.9%的感染者年龄在30岁以上,其中66.2%为女性,30.1%为家庭主妇。此外,43.6% 的人已婚,71.2% 的人至少受过中等教育。只有25.3%的人听说过猴痘,疫苗接种的比例为5.2%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与低 疫苗接种 率相关的主要因素是对 猴痘 症状的了解有限(ORa = 4.8;IC95%:1.72-13.80;p < 0.003)和 HIV 相关耻辱(ORa = 5.9;IC95%:2.01-17.68;p < 0.001)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调了信息、预防和公平获得卫生服务方面的巨大差距,强调迫切需要将 猴痘 疫苗接种 纳入艾滋病毒护理,特别是对于免疫功能低下的患者。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括横截面设计,它排除了因果推断,以及由于研究在金沙萨的背景而可能出现选择偏差。证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 引言:HIV–猴痘 共感染构成日益增长的挑战,因为感染人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)者的易感性增加,以及 传播 动力学的叠加。尽管在该人群中强烈推荐 疫苗接种,但疫苗接种覆盖率仍然低下,尤其在非洲。全球范围内,35,7% 的 HIV 感染者(PvVIH)已接种疫苗,但在非洲国家的比例明显更低,例如尼日利亚仅有 5% 接种了疫苗。这种低覆盖限制了对重症的预防,并凸显了改进疫苗获取策略的必要性。本研究的目标是确定在金沙萨影响 PvVIH 对 猴痘 的低疫苗接种率的因素。方法:这是一项在金沙萨市省 16 个卫生区的 64 家卫生机构开展的横断面分析研究。于 2025 年 10 月 5 日至 25 日期间,对 518 名 HIV 感染者进行数据收集。通过结构化、预先测试的问卷,由受过培训的调查员面对面访谈完成。统计分析使用 SPSS 25 版软件,显著性水平设为 5%。结果:结果显示,四分之三的 HIV 感染者(75,9%)年龄在 30 岁及以上。受访者中女性占多数(66,2%),30,1% 为家庭主妇。此外,43,6% 已婚,71,2% 受教育程度至少为高中。关于 PvVIH 对 猴痘 的认知,仅有 25,3% 曾听说过 猴痘。PvVIH 中接种 猴痘 的比例低,估计为 5,2%。导致低疫苗接种率的主要因素包括对 猴痘 症状认识有限(ORa = 4,8;IC95%: 1,72-13,80;p < 0,003),以及与 HIV 相关的污名化(ORa = 5,9;IC95%: 2,01-17,68;p < 0,001)。结论:本研究显示,金沙萨 HIV 感染者对 猴痘 的疫苗接种覆盖率极低,仅有 5,2% 的受试者接种疫苗,尽管其易感性增加。对 猴痘 的认知不足、持续的 HIV 污名和歧视是显著关联的因素。这些结果凸显了信息、预防和公平获取卫生服务方面的重大缺口,也表明迫切需要在 HIV 护理连续体中进一步整合 猴痘 疫苗接种,特别是针对免疫抑制患者。

title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.

title_zh: HECA-YOLOv11:一种高精度混合注意力网络,用于实时猴痘皮肤病变检测并具有可解释性
source_body_en: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.

title: Global immuno-epidemiology and the persistence of mpox clade IIb in MSM
abstract: In 2022, mpox clade IIb spread globally in men who have sex with men (MSM) via sexual contact. By summer 2022, case numbers declined in Europe and Norther America due to behavior change and immunization, with almost no reported cases in 2023, followed by low-level transmission. By autumn 2022, many susceptible individuals at high risk of transmission may have become immunized. Moreover, because individuals with mpox are infectious for only 2-4 weeks, sustaining transmission chains requires considerable infection throughput. This raises the question: How did mpox persist and transition to endemic circulation? We developed an agent-based model of mpox transmission on the Berlin MSM sexual contact network that incorporates viral shedding kinetics, vaccination, infection-derived immunity, immune waning, and case importations. After calibrating the model, we estimated that the probability of mpox extinction in Berlin exceeded 80% in 2023, when acquired immunity fragmented the transmission network. Extending the analysis to a European MSM metapopulation reduced the extinction probability to less than 60%, whereas incorporating global metapopulation dynamics reduced it to nearly zero. We find that mpox persistence was enabled by epidemic asynchrony: When transmission declined in Europe/the Americas, mpox transmission continued in Asia, long enough for immune waning to partially restore transmission potential in Europe, thereby enabling subsequent re-importation and endemic circulation. These model-based findings are supported by phylogenetic evidence indicating that all active German transmission clusters are either linked to (i) re-importation of clade F from the Americas, or (ii) the emergence of clades C and E linked to Asia. Our findings on asynchronous transmission across connected global MSM networks highlight the role of global immuno-epidemiology in enabling mpox persistence and emphasize the importance of coordinated international surveillance and control efforts.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 到 2022 年秋季,许多 传播 高风险易感个体可能已经接种疫苗。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 提供的证据没有明确说明研究设计、设置或研究人群。
elements_zh.methods: 我们在柏林 MSM 性接触网络上开发了基于代理的 猴痘 传播 模型,其中包含病毒脱落动力学、疫苗接种、感染源性免疫、免疫减弱和病例输入。
elements_zh.main_results: 到 2022 年夏季,由于行为改变和免疫接种,欧洲和北美的病例数有所下降,2023 年几乎没有病例报告,随后是低水平的 传播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们发现,猴痘 的持续存在是通过流行病异步实现的:当 猴痘 在欧洲/美洲下降时,猴痘 传播 在亚洲继续存在,足够长的时间使免疫减弱部分恢复 传播 在欧洲的潜力,从而实现随后的重新输入和地方性循环。

title_zh: 全球免疫流行病学与猴痘 IIb系在MSM中的持续传播
source_body_en: In 2022, mpox clade IIb spread globally in men who have sex with men (MSM) via sexual contact. By summer 2022, case numbers declined in Europe and Norther America due to behavior change and immunization, with almost no reported cases in 2023, followed by low-level transmission. By autumn 2022, many susceptible individuals at high risk of transmission may have become immunized. Moreover, because individuals with mpox are infectious for only 2-4 weeks, sustaining transmission chains requires considerable infection throughput. This raises the question: How did mpox persist and transition to endemic circulation? We developed an agent-based model of mpox transmission on the Berlin MSM sexual contact network that incorporates viral shedding kinetics, vaccination, infection-derived immunity, immune waning, and case importations. After calibrating the model, we estimated that the probability of mpox extinction in Berlin exceeded 80% in 2023, when acquired immunity fragmented the transmission network. Extending the analysis to a European MSM metapopulation reduced the extinction probability to less than 60%, whereas incorporating global metapopulation dynamics reduced it to nearly zero. We find that mpox persistence was enabled by epidemic asynchrony: When transmission declined in Europe/the Americas, mpox transmission continued in Asia, long enough for immune waning to partially restore transmission potential in Europe, thereby enabling subsequent re-importation and endemic circulation. These model-based findings are supported by phylogenetic evidence indicating that all active German transmission clusters are either linked to (i) re-importation of clade F from the Americas, or (ii) the emergence of clades C and E linked to Asia. Our findings on asynchronous transmission across connected global MSM networks highlight the role of global immuno-epidemiology in enabling mpox persistence and emphasize the importance of coordinated international surveillance and control efforts.
abstract_zh: 2022 年,猴痘 进化枝 IIb 在通过性接触发生男男性行为 (MSM) 的男性中在全球范围内传播。到 2022 年夏季,由于行为改变和免疫接种,欧洲和北美的病例数有所下降,2023 年几乎没有病例报告,随后是低水平的 传播。到 2022 年秋季,许多 传播 高风险易感个体可能已经接种疫苗。此外,由于携带 猴痘 的个体的传染性只有 2-4 周,因此维持 传播 链需要相当大的感染吞吐量。这就提出了一个问题:猴痘 是如何持续存在并转变为地方性循环的?我们在柏林 MSM 性接触网络上开发了基于代理的 猴痘 传播 模型,其中包含病毒脱落动力学、疫苗接种、感染源性免疫、免疫减弱和病例输入。校准模型后,我们估计,到 2023 年,当获得性免疫使 传播 网络支离破碎时,猴痘 在柏林灭绝的概率超过 80%。将分析扩展到欧洲 MSM 集合种群,将灭绝概率降低至 60% 以下,而纳入全球集合种群动态,则将灭绝概率降至接近零。我们发现,猴痘 的持续存在是通过流行病异步实现的:当 猴痘 在欧洲/美洲下降时,猴痘 传播 在亚洲继续存在,足够长的时间使免疫减弱部分恢复 传播 在欧洲的潜力,从而实现随后的重新输入和地方性循环。这些基于模型的发现得到了系统发育证据的支持,表明所有活跃的德国 传播 簇要么与(i)从美洲重新输入进化枝 F 相关,要么(ii)与亚洲相关的进化枝 C 和 E 的出现有关。我们对跨连接的全球 MSM 网络的异步 传播 的研究结果强调了全球免疫 流行病学 在实现 猴痘 持久性方面的作用,并强调了协调国际 监测 和控制工作的重要性。

title: Two for the price of one: should donovanosis and chancroid be targeted for eradication?
abstract: Half a century after smallpox eradication, this feat has not been repeated, although there is hope for the Guinea worm. This article examines whether two uncommon genital ulcerative diseases, donovanosis and chancroid, should be targeted for eradication. Many think that their decline has been such that they might be heading towards spontaneous eradication, following more effective treatments, integration of sexually transmitted infection management in primary healthcare, enhanced condom use by sex workers and promotion of male circumcision. However, examples of syphilis and mpox suggest spontaneous eradication may be a fallacy. Donovanosis occurs sporadically in several countries, especially India. In other formerly endemic nations (eg, Papua New Guinea and the Papua region of Indonesia), the current epidemiological situation is unclear. Worldwide incidence might be a few hundred cases annually, perhaps a thousand. The availability of effective interventions, relatively easy clinical diagnosis, adequate laboratory tests and the absence of animal reservoirs suggest that eradication could be achieved through enhanced surveillance and a stronger contact tracing system with presumptive treatment of all sexual contacts, including sex workers. Chancroid’s current annual caseload is unknown but likely in the hundreds of thousands of cases globally. Prior to eradication activities, a first phase should document its status in all previously endemic countries using molecular tests on patients presenting with genital ulcers in sentinel clinics. Additional research should investigate whether Haemophilus ducreyi in skin ulcers can cause genital infections. Chancroid is strongly associated with sex work: this is the tap that must be turned off. Where it remains endemic, sex workers’ services should be supported to treat symptomatic cases, enhance condom use and deliver periodic presumptive treatment with azithromycin. Given their overlapping geographic distribution and the preponderant role of sex workers in transmission dynamics, an eradication programme could address both diseases simultaneously, with the same personnel.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review explores whether donovanosis and chancroid, two uncommon genital ulcerative diseases, should be targeted for eradication. It considers their epidemiological status, potential for spontaneous eradication, and the feasibility of eradication programs.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative analysis of the current epidemiological and clinical status of donovanosis and chancroid. It does not report specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods. The authors focus on general observations and recommendations for surveillance and intervention.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review suggests that donovanosis and chancroid may be declining and could potentially be eradicated through enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and treatment of sexual contacts. However, it also notes that spontaneous eradication may not be reliable, as seen with syphilis and mpox.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights uncertainty about the current epidemiological status of chancroid in formerly endemic countries. It also raises questions about the role of Haemophilus ducreyi in causing genital infections and the effectiveness of interventions in reducing transmission.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends a first phase of documenting the status of donovanosis and chancroid in all previously endemic countries using molecular tests. It also suggests supporting sex workers' services to treat cases, enhance condom use, and deliver periodic presumptive treatment with azithromycin.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates whether donovanosis and chancroid, two uncommon genital ulcerative diseases, should be targeted for eradication. It notes that while their decline may suggest potential for spontaneous eradication, examples like syphilis and mpox indicate that this may not be reliable. The review highlights the need for enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and treatment of sexual contacts, particularly sex workers, to achieve eradication. It also emphasizes the importance of documenting the current status of these diseases in previously endemic countries and investigating the role of Haemophilus ducreyi in genital infections. The authors suggest that an eradication program could address both diseases simultaneously, leveraging shared transmission dynamics and resources.

Many think that their decline has been such that they might be heading towards spontaneous eradication, following more effective treatments, integration of sexually transmitted infection management in primary healthcare, enhanced condom use by sex workers and promotion of male circumcision. However, examples of syphilis and mpox suggest spontaneous eradication may be a fallacy. Donovanosis occurs sporadically in several countries, especially India. In other formerly endemic nations (eg, Papua New Guinea and the Papua region of Indonesia), the current epidemiological situation is unclear. Worldwide incidence might be a few hundred cases annually, perhaps a thousand. The availability of effective interventions, relatively easy clinical diagnosis, adequate laboratory tests and the absence of animal reservoirs suggest that eradication could be achieved through enhanced surveillance and a stronger contact tracing system with presumptive treatment of all sexual contacts, including sex workers. Chancroid’s current annual caseload is unknown but likely in the hundreds of thousands of cases globally. Prior to eradication activities, a first phase should document its status in all previously endemic countries using molecular tests on patients presenting with genital ulcers in sentinel clinics. Additional research should investigate whether Haemophilus ducreyi in skin ulcers can cause genital infections. Chancroid is strongly associated with sex work: this is the tap that must be turned off. Where it remains endemic, sex workers’ services should be supported to treat symptomatic cases, enhance condom use and deliver periodic presumptive treatment with azithromycin. Given their overlapping geographic distribution and the preponderant role of sex workers in transmission dynamics, an eradication programme could address both diseases simultaneously, with the same personnel.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了是否应该根除多诺万病和软下疳这两种罕见的生殖器溃疡性疾病。它考虑了它们的流行病学状况、自发根除的潜力以及根除计划的可行性。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对多诺万病和软下疳当前流行病学和临床状况的叙述性分析。它不报告特定的数据库、搜索日期或荟萃分析方法。作者重点关注 监测 和干预的一般观察和建议。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查表明,多诺万病和软下疳可能正在减少,并且有可能通过加强 监测、接触者追踪和性接触的 治疗 来根除。然而,它也指出,自发根除可能并不可靠,正如梅毒和 猴痘 所见。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调了以前软下疳流行国家当前流行病学状况的不确定性。它还对杜克雷嗜血杆菌在引起生殖器感染中的作用以及减少 传播 的干预措施的有效性提出了疑问。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 审查建议第一阶段使用分子检测记录所有以前流行的国家多诺万病和软下疳的状况。它还建议支持性工作者的服务,以治疗病例,加强安全套的使用,并定期使用阿奇霉素进行推定 治疗。

title: From detection to prediction: Asymptomatic shedding-informed mass-balance modeling predicts travel-borne viral importation at airports.
abstract: Aircraft wastewater surveillance (AWS) has emerged as a non-invasive tool for travel-mediated pathogen detection, yet its utility remains largely descriptive without capacity to translate environmental concentrations into quantitative infection dynamics. This study aimed to advance AWS from passive pathogen detection to an active predictive framework by integrating mass balance back-calculation with hybrid-capture genomic surveillance. To resolve a critical parameter gap in mass-balance modeling-namely, the fecal shedding kinetics of asymptomatic influenza carriers, we prospectively enrolled 238 non-respiratory outpatients at Nanchang People's Hospital and quantified fecal influenza A/B virus loads (IAV /IBV) by RT-qPCR. Asymptomatic IAV and IBV shedding was detected across all age strata, with median viral loads of 5.9 and 5.0 log10 copies/g, respectively, and positivity rates ranging from 41.2% (adolescents) to 62.1% (children <10 years), thereby establishing the first empirical fecal shedding parameter set for carriage-inclusive mass-balance back-calculation. Between January and July 2025, we prospectively collected 240 aircraft wastewater samples from six Asia-Pacific flight routes and 60 longitudinal sewage samples from an international airport in Nanjing, China. RT-qPCR was conducted to quantify norovirus, influenza virus, mpox, and dengue virus. A mass balance back-calculation model was established to convert wastewater viral concentrations into estimated weekly numbers of infected inbound passengers. Viral genomes were enriched via hybrid-capture panels and subjected to high-resolution phylogenetic analysis. The predictive framework estimated weekly flight-imported infection cases for norovirus GII, influenza A virus and dengue virus, revealing distinct regional importation curves synchronized with epidemiological trends in countries of origin (95% concordance). Phylogenetic analysis resolved multiple independent viral introductions. Further employing a Susceptible-Exposed-Infectious-Recovered model, we forecasted 14-day community infection burden and validated predictions against clinical surveillance data, demonstrating significant concordance with IAV (r=0.71) and norovirus clinical visits (r=0.84). By bridging quantitative infection dynamics with lineage-resolution genomics, this study establishes a paradigm shift from qualitative pathogen detection to predictive outbreak intelligence.

abstract_zh: 航空废水(AWS)作为一种非侵入性的旅行媒介病原体检测工具已崭露头角,但其应用仍主要停留在描述性层面,缺乏将环境浓度转化为定量感染动态的能力。本研究旨在通过将质能平衡逆向计算与混合捕获技术相结合,将AWS从被动病原体检测推进到主动预测框架。为解决质能平衡建模中的关键参数缺口——即无症状流感携带者的粪便排毒动力学,我们前瞻性地招募了238名非呼吸系统门诊患者,并通过RT-qPCR量化了粪便中流感A/B病毒载量(IAV/IBV)。无症状IAV和IBV排毒在所有年龄层中均被检测到,其中中位病毒载量分别为5.9和5.0 log10 copies/g,阳性率范围从41.2%(青少年)到62.1%(<10岁儿童),从而建立了首个包含携带者的质能平衡逆向计算经验性粪便排毒参数集。2025年1月至7月期间,我们前瞻性地从六个亚太航线收集了240份航空废水样本,并从中国南京的国际机场收集了60份纵向污水样本。通过RT-qPCR量化了诺如病毒、流感病毒、猴痘和登革病毒。建立了一个质能平衡逆向计算模型,将废水中的病毒浓度转化为估计的每周入境感染乘客数量。病毒基因组通过混合捕获面板进行富集,并进行高分辨率系统发育分析。预测框架估计了诺如病毒GII、流感A病毒和登革病毒的每周航空输入感染病例,揭示了与原发国流行趋势同步的区域输入曲线(95%一致性)。系统发育分析解析了多个独立的病毒引入事件。进一步采用易感-暴露-感染-恢复(SEIR)模型,我们预测了14天内的社区感染负担,并将预测结果与临床监测数据进行验证,显示出与IAV(r=0.71)和诺如病毒临床就诊(r=0.84)显著的一致性。通过将定量感染动态与谱系分辨率基因组学相结合,本研究确立了从定性病原体检测向预测暴发智能的范式转变。

title: The anthropogenic fingerprint on emerging infectious diseases.
abstract: Abstract Emerging infectious diseases are a hallmark of the Anthropocene 1,2 . Human-driven ecosystem changes and human–wildlife–livestock contact can drive the emergence of zoonotic and vector-borne diseases 3–5 , but how much these processes shape landscapes of outbreak risk is poorly understood, beyond a few well-studied systems 6–8 . Here we consolidate 58,319 outbreak event records for 32 diseases and systematically test how 16 hypothesized social and environmental drivers impact outbreak geographies, while accounting for detection and reporting biases. We show that outbreak risks are typically highest in mosaic landscapes where people and livestock live alongside forests and fragmented ecosystems. These combined factors, along with long-term declines in precipitation, share strong impacts across several vector-borne diseases (for example, dengue, Lyme disease and zoonotic arboviruses). By contrast, directly transmitted zoonoses (for example, Ebola and mpox) share few common drivers, and the impacts of most other anthropogenic pressures (for example, deforestation, climate warming and agricultural intensification) vary widely between diseases. Most consistently, the observed geography of outbreaks is shaped by healthcare access: reporting declines by a median of 32% (range across diseases: 1.2–96.7%) for each additional hour’s travel time from a health facility. Our findings underscore that infectious disease spillover and emergence are multi-causal, and that no one-size-fits-all strategy can prevent epidemics and pandemics. Ecosystem-based public health interventions 9 should always follow system-specific evidence, and be paired with greater investment in health systems and One Health pathogen surveillance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how human-driven changes shape the risk of emerging infectious diseases, particularly focusing on the factors that influence outbreak patterns of mpox virus.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research consolidated 58,319 outbreak event records for 32 diseases, including mpox virus, and systematically tested the impact of 16 hypothesized social and environmental drivers on outbreak geographies.
analysis.methods: The study accounted for detection and reporting biases, and analyzed how factors such as healthcare access, ecosystem changes, and human–wildlife–livestock contact influence the geography of outbreaks for mpox virus.

It consolidates 58,319 outbreak records for 32 diseases and systematically tests the impact of social and environmental drivers on outbreak geographies. Healthcare access is identified as a key factor, with reporting declining by a median of 32% for each additional hour’s travel time from a health facility. The study highlights the importance of system-specific evidence and greater investment in health systems and pathogen surveillance. elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于对暴发事件记录的依赖以及潜在的报告偏差,但由于其系统的方法和大规模数据集,证据是强有力的。

abstract_zh: 摘要 新兴传染病是人类世的标志性现象1,2。人类驱动的生态系统变化以及人类与野生动物和家畜的接触可以推动人兽共患病和暴发媒介传染病的出现3–5,但这些过程如何塑造暴发风险景观仍知之甚少,除了少数被广泛研究的系统6–8。在此,我们整合了32种疾病共计58,319个暴发事件记录,系统地测试了16种假设的社会和环境驱动因素如何影响暴发的地理分布,同时考虑了检测和报告偏差。我们发现,暴发风险通常在混合景观中最高,即人类和家畜与森林及破碎生态系统共存的地区。这些综合因素,加上长期降水量的下降,对几种媒介媒介传染病(例如登革热、莱姆病和人兽共源性虫媒病毒)具有显著的共同影响。相比之下,直接传播的人兽共患病(例如埃博拉病毒和猴痘)共享的驱动因素较少,而大多数其他人类活动压力(例如森林砍伐、气候变暖和农业集约化)对不同疾病的影响差异较大。最一致的是,观察到的暴发地理分布受到医疗资源可及性的显著影响:每增加一小时前往医疗机构的旅行时间,报告数量就会中位数下降32%(不同疾病之间的范围为1.2–96.7%)。我们的研究结果强调,传染病的跨物种溢出和出现是多因素驱动的,没有一种适用于所有情况的策略能够有效预防大流行和疫情。基于生态系统的公共卫生干预措施9应始终基于特定系统的证据,并与对卫生系统和One Health病原体监测的更大投资相结合。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解人类驱动的变化如何塑造新兴传染病的风险,特别是关注影响猴痘病毒模式的因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究整合了32种疾病共计58,319个暴发事件记录,包括猴痘病毒,并系统地测试了16种假设的社会和环境驱动因素对暴发地理分布的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究考虑了检测和报告偏差,并分析了医疗资源可及性、生态系统变化以及人类与野生动物和家畜接触等因素如何影响暴发的地理分布。
analysis_zh.main_results: 对于猴痘病毒,其暴发风险在混合景观中最高,即人类和家畜与森林及破碎生态系统共存的地区。医疗资源可及性与暴发报告之间存在最一致的关联,每增加一小时前往医疗机构的旅行时间,报告数量就会中位数下降32%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调,猴痘病毒的暴发受到多种因素的影响,没有单一策略能够有效防止其出现。此外,研究还表明,人类活动压力对不同疾病的影响存在差异。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为针对猴痘病毒的公共卫生干预措施提供了信息,强调了需要基于特定系统的证据以及改善医疗资源可及性和病原体监测的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于对暴发事件记录的依赖以及潜在的报告偏差,但由于其系统的方法和大规模数据集,证据是强有力的。

title: A within-host-informed event-time framework linking epidemiological delay distributions
abstract: Understanding when and how pathogens spread from person to person is fundamental to characterizing transmission, interpreting surveillance data, and designing effective control measures. Yet key epidemiological delays -- including the latent period, incubation period, generation interval, and serial interval -- are difficult to estimate because key events such as infection, infectiousness, symptom onset, and transmission are rarely observed directly. Current approaches typically estimate these delays using flexible statistical distributions rather than explicitly linking them through the underlying processes that generate them, making it difficult to interpret the underlying biology and to ensure consistency across related delay estimates. Here, we develop a stochastic event-time framework built around a dynamic within-host pathogen-growth model that treats epidemiological delays as coupled outcomes of a shared biological process. By representing these key events as linked stochastic events, the framework produces internally consistent delay distributions while inferring parameters with mechanistic interpretations conditional on the assumed within-host model that govern pathogen growth, clearance, infectiousness, and symptom onset. The framework also accommodates censored and partially observed infection and symptom-onset times through a unified observation model. Across simulation studies, the framework accurately recovered generation-interval characteristics across sample sizes and disease time scales. In applications to SARS-CoV-2 and mpox transmission-pair data, the framework showed improved predictive fit relative to conventional lognormal delay models in several analyses, although the magnitude of improvement varied across datasets and observation models; it estimated shorter generation intervals for Omicron than Delta and revealed alternative within-host parameters compatible with the mpox transmission data. This mechanistic framework provides a biologically interpretable alternative to independently fitted delay distributions, yields internally consistent estimates of epidemiological delays, and establishes a foundation for integrating biological and epidemiological data to better understand, predict, and control pathogen transmission.

Current approaches typically estimate these delays using flexible statistical distributions rather than explicitly linking them through the underlying processes that generate them, making it difficult to interpret the underlying biology and to ensure consistency across related delay estimates. Here, we develop a stochastic event-time framework built around a dynamic within-host pathogen-growth model that treats epidemiological delays as coupled outcomes of a shared biological process. By representing these key events as linked stochastic events, the framework produces internally consistent delay distributions while inferring parameters with mechanistic interpretations conditional on the assumed within-host model that govern pathogen growth, clearance, infectiousness, and symptom onset. The framework also accommodates censored and partially observed infection and symptom-onset times through a unified observation model. Across simulation studies, the framework accurately recovered generation-interval characteristics across sample sizes and disease time scales. In applications to SARS-CoV-2 and mpox transmission-pair data, the framework showed improved predictive fit relative to conventional lognormal delay models in several analyses, although the magnitude of improvement varied across datasets and observation models; it estimated shorter generation intervals for Omicron than Delta and revealed alternative within-host parameters compatible with the mpox transmission data. This mechanistic framework provides a biologically interpretable alternative to independently fitted delay distributions, yields internally consistent estimates of epidemiological delays, and establishes a foundation for integrating biological and epidemiological data to better understand, predict, and control pathogen transmission.

The findings have implications for improving surveillance and control strategies for mpox and other similar viruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 了解病原体在人与人之间传播的时间和方式对于描述传播、解释监测数据以及设计有效的控制措施至关重要。本研究旨在解决估计关键流行病学延迟(如潜伏期、潜伏期、代际间隔和连续间隔)的挑战,这些延迟由于诸如感染和症状出现等关键事件很少被直接观察而难以测量。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究开发了一个随机事件时间框架,将流行病学延迟与宿主内部病原体动态联系起来。它将该框架应用于SARS-CoV-2和猴痘 传播配对数据,分析模型在不同样本量和疾病时间尺度下的表现。
elements_zh.methods: 该框架使用动态的宿主内部病原体增长模型,将流行病学延迟视为共享生物过程的结果。它结合了一个统一的观察模型,以处理被审查和部分观察的感染和症状出现时间,从而允许估计代际间隔和其他延迟参数。
elements_zh.main_results: 该框架在多个分析中相对于传统对数正态延迟模型显示出改进的预测拟合度,尽管不同数据集和观察模型中改进的程度有所不同。它估计了Omicron的代际间隔比Delta更短,并揭示了与猴痘 传播数据兼容的替代宿主内部参数。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该框架为独立拟合的延迟分布提供了可解释的生物学替代方案,产生了内部一致的流行病学延迟估计。它为整合生物学和流行病学数据奠定了基础,以更好地理解、预测和控制病原体传播。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了一种方法,以提高流行病学延迟估计的准确性,从而为监测、诊断以及猴痘和其他病原体的控制策略提供信息。这种方法增强了对病原体传播动态建模的能力,并有助于设计针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的结果基于模拟研究和对SARS-CoV-2和猴痘数据的应用,这可能限制其普遍适用性。该框架在不同数据集和观察模型中的表现表明其证据强度中等,因为预测拟合度的改进程度有所不同。

abstract_zh: 了解病原体在人与人之间传播的时间和方式对于描述传播、解释监测数据以及设计有效的控制措施至关重要。然而,关键的流行病学延迟(包括潜伏期、潜伏期、代际间隔和连续间隔)难以估计,因为诸如感染、传染性、症状出现和传播等关键事件很少被直接观察到。当前的方法通常使用灵活的统计分布来估计这些延迟,而不是通过生成这些延迟的潜在生物过程显式地将它们联系起来,这使得理解其潜在生物学机制以及确保相关延迟估计之间的一致性变得困难。在这里,我们开发了一个基于动态的宿主内部病原体增长模型的随机事件时间框架,将流行病学延迟视为共享生物过程的耦合结果。通过将这些关键事件表示为相互关联的随机事件,该框架在推断参数时能够产生内部一致的延迟分布,并基于所假设的宿主模型(该模型控制病原体增长、清除、传染性和症状出现)进行机制性解释。该框架还通过统一的观察模型处理被审查和部分观察的感染和症状出现时间。在模拟研究中,该框架在不同样本量和疾病时间尺度下准确恢复了代际间隔特征。在应用于SARS-CoV-2和猴痘 传播配对数据时,该框架在多个分析中相对于传统对数正态延迟模型显示出改进的预测拟合度,尽管不同数据集和观察模型中改进的程度有所不同;它估计了Omicron的代际间隔比Delta更短,并揭示了与猴痘 传播数据兼容的替代宿主内部参数。这种机制性框架为独立拟合的延迟分布提供了可解释的生物学替代方案,产生了内部一致的流行病学延迟估计,并为整合生物学和流行病学数据奠定了基础,以更好地理解、预测和控制病原体传播。

title: The public health value of wastewater surveillance for viruses with pandemic potential: a modelling study
abstract: Zoonotic spillover and early human-to-human transmission of emerging viruses are often missed by clinical surveillance. Wastewater surveillance (WS) offers low-cost complementary pathogen detection, but its value for emerging viruses remains uncertain. We reviewed evidence of viral shedding in human waste and combined shedding data, detection models and simulated transmission dynamics into a quantitative framework to identify for which types of emerging viruses WS could add most value. Simulations showed that WS improved probability or speed of outbreak detection for viruses shedding >1/100 to >10 times as much as SARS-CoV-2, depending on probability of clinical symptoms and diagnosis. Value added was highest for transmission scenarios with temporally concentrated infections resulting in spikes in daily shedders. Characteristics of SARS-CoV-2, Mpox, Influenza A, Lassa, and Zaire Ebola viruses appear more favourable for WS than others e.g. We anticipate this framework can support more targeted, evidence-based application of WS to emerging threats.
